holders: the shared Codex app-server daemon (left running; the driver never stops it) may hold the directory of a thread it loaded under scratch; it is released on `codex app-server daemon stop`, or when the daemon unloads the thread (documented: no subscribers and no thread activity for 30 minutes). The driver does not call thread/archive or thread/delete, which would unload it sooner, because both write to the operator's Codex thread store (thread/delete destroys the run's rollout) and whether their shutdown releases the directory handle is unverified
